# Vault Instructions

This is an Obsidian-compatible markdown vault managed by Zenod. Two tiers:

- **Evidence** (`Log/`, `_attachments/`) — append-only, immutable, block-ID anchors (`^e-xxxxxx`).
- **Meaning** (`Areas/`, `Projects/`, `Notes/`) — living pages; every evidence-derived claim cites its evidence; no orphan pages.

`Inbox/` holds only unresolved items awaiting the user. Frontmatter and tag vocabulary are enforced by `.brain/config.yml` — see the Zenod docs.
